vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: persona-customer-support
Version: 1.0.11

The skill bundle defines a customer support persona that utilizes Google Workspace tools (via the 'gws' binary) for email triage, task management, and scheduling. All instructions in SKILL.md are consistent with the stated purpose of managing support tickets, and no malicious patterns, data exfiltration, or suspicious execution logic were identified.

llm.summary: The skill's requests and instructions are coherent with a Google Workspace–centric customer support persona; it is instruction-only and does not ask for unrelated secrets or install anything surprising.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (customer support) match the instructions (triage Gmail, create tasks, update Sheets, escalate to Chat, create Calendar events). Requiring the 'gws' CLI and the listed gws-* utility skills is consistent with that goal.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only instructs the agent to run gws commands and workflows related to email, sheets, chat, and calendar. It does not ask the agent to read unrelated files, access other env vars, or transmit data to unexpected endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or downloadable code is provided (instruction-only), so nothing new is written to disk by this skill. The only runtime requirement is an existing 'gws' binary on PATH.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill itself declares no environment variables or credentials, which is reasonable because it delegates to the gws-* utility skills. However, interacting with Gmail/Sheets/Chat/Calendar will require credentials handled by those utility skills — verify those skills' credential requirements and scopes before enabling.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent system changes. Model invocation is allowed (platform default) which is expected for a persona skill; nothing in this skill asserts elevated or always-present privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and coherent for a Google Workspace support persona, but before installing: 1) confirm the origin and trustworthiness of the 'gws' CLI (it must already be on PATH) — untrusted CLIs can be risky; 2) review the gws-gmail, gws-sheets, gws-chat, and gws-calendar utility skills to see what credentials/scopes they require and whether those permissions are appropriate (least privilege); 3) ensure account tokens/keys used by the utility skills are stored and rotated securely; and 4) if you do not recognize the owner/source, consider testing in a limited environment or with least-privileged accounts first.
